summary: Grok videos use grok-imagine-video-1.5 at native 1080p (720p with character pictures), and every Grok video prompt ends with anatomy guidance (one head, one body, no duplicated or stacked characters). All Grok writing (video ideas, captions, stories, assistant) uses the flagship grok-4.7; settings still on the old grok-4.3 default move up once. Make a video starts at the longest length (Grok 15 s, Kling 10 s) and remembers the length the user picks, so it no longer falls back to 8 s when the panel opens again; suggested ideas use the longest length.
